issues.description: The problem statement requires an attribute named `status_flag` to be defined as a single byte, but the solution defines `status_flag` as a double word (`dd`), and the template does not define `status_flag` at all. This creates ambiguity about whether students must add `status_flag` and what its correct size should be.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts: either remove the `status_flag` requirement from the problem statement if it is not part of the exercise, or add `status_flag db 1` (or similar) to the template and change the solution to `status_flag db 1` to match the stated single-byte requirement.
